summary: Static code review of widget refresh fix (react-native-android-widget). All 5 verification points PASS. Every `clickAction="REFRESH_AGENDA"` in all 3 widget files (AgendaWidget, AgendaWeekWidget, AgendaPlusWidget) has a matching `clickActionData={{}}` on the very next line inside the same JSX prop block. No other clickAction values (OPEN_APP/OPEN_URI) exist. The task handler correctly dispatches to renderAgenda/renderWeek/renderPlus for the 3 widgetNames and triggers fetchFresh() on WIDGET_CLICK, WIDGET_UPDATE and WIDGET_ADDED. app.json declares updatePeriodMillis and resizeMode for all 3 widgets. Token pipeline (readLatestTokens → restWithRetry → refreshAccessToken on 401 → writeSessionEverywhere writing BOTH widget cache and sb-family-auth-session) is intact. HTTP smoke test: 200. NOTE: Only a fresh EAS Android build will apply the native fix on-device — the user's existing installed build must be rebuilt/reinstalled.

AgendaWidget.tsx.no_other_clickActions: PASS — grep confirms only REFRESH_AGENDA present

point_2_handler_dispatch.shouldFetch_expression: line 316: `shouldFetch = isClick || isPeriodic || isAdded` — where isClick=WIDGET_CLICK (l.311), isPeriodic=WIDGET_UPDATE (l.312), isAdded=WIDGET_ADDED (l.313). fetchFresh() called at line 317.

point_4_session_token_pipeline.refreshAccessToken_on_401: restWithRetry() line 174-179 calls refreshAccessToken(cache) when r.status===401 and retries
point_4_session_token_pipeline.writes_to_both_stores: writeSessionEverywhere (l.93-118): (1) updates widget cache via writeCache (l.99), (2) writes to AsyncStorage under SUPABASE_SESSION_KEY='sb-family-auth-session' (l.15, l.116)

minor_style_observations: In AgendaWidget.tsx (l.104), AgendaWeekWidget.tsx (l.84) and AgendaPlusWidget.tsx (l.127) the `clickActionData={{}}` line is indented 6 spaces while the sibling `clickAction="REFRESH_AGENDA"` is indented 8 spaces — purely cosmetic, does NOT affect the JSX prop parsing or the fix (both props still land on the same element). Optional: run Prettier for consistent indentation.
action_items: None required for the fix itself — all 5 verification points PASS.

IMPORTANT: User must generate and install a NEW EAS Android build. The native RNWidgetProvider.java NPE fix only takes effect when a fresh build is installed; the user's existing installed APK/AAB will continue to crash silently on tap.
Optional cosmetic: normalize indentation of the `clickActionData={{}}` lines (l.104 AgendaWidget, l.84 AgendaWeekWidget, l.127 AgendaPlusWidget).
critical_code_review_comments: Fix is correctly applied on every clickAction site — no missing pair.

Token pipeline is robust: readLatestTokens compares expires_at between supabase-js session and widget cache and picks the freshest; on 401 refresh is retried and the refreshed session is persisted to BOTH stores, avoiding the 'user gets logged out after background refresh' class of bugs.
widgetTaskHandler dispatches by widgetInfo.widgetName which matches the three names declared in app.json ('Agenda', 'AgendaWeek', 'AgendaPlus') — no name-mismatch risk.
All 3 widgets share fetchFresh() so the auth refresh behavior is uniform.
